name: mycelium-extra
description: Repository-aware, bounded challenge and scoping for research and software work

interface.longDescription: Search project memory and code before asking, challenge consequential assumptions, ask only questions the user must answer, and return a sourced step-by-step plan that waits for approval before anything runs. Settle which past Mycelium decision binds a task, and record the user's resolution as a new decision entry. Check a plan's sample-table assumptions (cohort, unit of replication, pairing, batch) before anything runs. Turn on the plan-approval gate in a repository (Claude Code).
defaultPrompt: Grill this analysis plan against the current repository and give me a sourced step-by-step plan before running anything.
